description: Source code defining the CKEDITOR.dom.range class, which manages text and element ranges within the CKEditor WYSIWYG editor, including methods for manipulating, cloning, and analyzing document ranges.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dom.range
classes.description: Class representing a document range with methods for range manipulation, cloning, boundary checking, and content operations within CKEditor.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the range object with the same boundaries and state.

methods.name: collapse
methods.description: Collapses the range to its start or end point.

methods.name: cloneContents
methods.description: Returns a document fragment containing a clone of the range's contents.

methods.name: deleteContents
methods.description: Removes the contents of the range from the DOM.

methods.name: extractContents
methods.description: Removes and returns the contents of the range as a document fragment.

methods.name: createBookmark
methods.description: Creates a bookmark in the range for later restoration, including span tags in the DOM.

methods.name: createBookmark2
methods.description: Creates a mutation-sensitive, normalized bookmark for the range.

methods.name: moveToBookmark
methods.description: Restores the range boundaries from a previously created bookmark.

methods.name: getBoundaryNodes
methods.description: Returns the start and end nodes of the range.

methods.name: getCommonAncestor
methods.description: Finds the closest common ancestor node of the range boundaries.

methods.name: optimize
methods.description: Transforms range boundaries from text nodes to element nodes where possible.

methods.name: optimizeBookmark
methods.description: Adjusts range boundaries out of bookmark nodes.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Trims whitespace or empty nodes from the start and end of the range.

methods.name: enlarge
methods.description: Enlarges the range boundaries to include larger document structures based on specified units.

methods.name: shrink
methods.description: Shrinks the range boundaries to the innermost elements or text nodes.

methods.name: insertNode
methods.description: Inserts a node at the start of the range and expands the range to include it.

methods.name: moveToPosition
methods.description: Moves the range to a specific position within a node and collapses it.

methods.name: selectNodeContents
methods.description: Selects the entire contents of a node.

methods.name: setStart
methods.description: Sets the start boundary of the range.

methods.name: setEnd
methods.description: Sets the end boundary of the range.

methods.name: setStartAfter
methods.description: Sets the start boundary after a specified node.

methods.name: setStartBefore
methods.description: Sets the start boundary before a specified node.

methods.name: setEndAfter
methods.description: Sets the end boundary after a specified node.

methods.name: setEndBefore
methods.description: Sets the end boundary before a specified node.

methods.name: setStartAt
methods.description: Sets the start boundary at a specific position within a node.

methods.name: setEndAt
methods.description: Sets the end boundary at a specific position within a node.

methods.name: fixBlock
methods.description: Adjusts the range to fix block boundaries, optionally wrapping in a block element.

methods.name: splitBlock
methods.description: Splits the block element at the range boundaries.

methods.name: splitElement
methods.description: Splits an element at the range boundary, creating a new branch.

methods.name: checkBoundaryOfElement
methods.description: Checks if the range boundary is at the inner boundary of a specified element.

methods.name: checkStartOfBlock
methods.description: Checks if the range start is at the start of a block.

methods.name: checkEndOfBlock
methods.description: Checks if the range end is at the end of a block.

methods.name: moveToElementEditablePosition
methods.description: Moves the range to the first or last editable position within an element.

methods.name: moveToElementEditStart
methods.description: Moves the range to the start position inside an element.

methods.name: moveToElementEditEnd
methods.description: Moves the range to the end position inside an element.

methods.name: getEnclosedNode
methods.description: Returns the single node enclosed within the range if only one exists.

methods.name: getTouchedStartNode
methods.description: Returns the node touched at the start boundary of the range.

methods.name: getTouchedEndNode
methods.description: Returns the node touched at the end boundary of the range.
